stem.en: I'm going to ___ my hair cut tomorrow.

why.en: Have + object + past participle means someone else does it for you: have my hair cut.
why.uz: Have + toʻldiruvchi + uchinchi shakl ishni siz uchun boshqa kishi bajarishini bildiradi: have my hair cut.
why.ru: Have + дополнение + третья форма: это делает для вас кто-то другой: have my hair cut.

stem.en: We had our flat ___ last summer.

why.en: In the causative have + object + past participle, the verb is in the third form: painted.
why.uz: Have + toʻldiruvchi + uchinchi shakl qurilmasida feʼl uchinchi shaklda boʻladi: painted.
why.ru: В конструкции have + дополнение + третья форма глагол стоит в третьей форме: painted.

stem.en: I got my brother ___ me with the boxes.

why.en: Get + person + to + verb means persuade someone to do something: got my brother to help.
why.uz: Get + kishi + to + feʼl kimnidir biror ishga koʻndirishni bildiradi: got my brother to help.
why.ru: Get + человек + to + глагол — уговорить кого-то что-то сделать: got my brother to help.

stem.en: I have two brothers, both of ___ live in Tashkent.

why.en: After a preposition (both of), a relative pronoun for people is whom.
why.uz: Predlogdan keyin (both of) odamlar uchun nisbiy olmosh whom boʻladi.
why.ru: После предлога (both of) относительное местоимение для людей — whom.

stem.en: The house ___ we grew up has been sold.

why.en: We grew up in the house, so the preposition goes before which: in which.
why.uz: Biz uyda (in the house) oʻsganmiz, shuning uchun predlog which dan oldin turadi: in which.
why.ru: Мы выросли в доме (in the house), поэтому предлог ставится перед which: in which.

stem.en: The man to ___ I spoke on the phone was very polite.

why.en: Directly after a preposition (to), a person is referred to with whom.
why.uz: Predlogdan (to) keyin shaxsga whom orqali ishora qilinadi.
why.ru: Сразу после предлога (to) о человеке говорят whom.

stem.en: She gave me three books, none of ___ I had read.

why.en: After none of in a relative clause about things, we use which; them would need a new sentence.
why.uz: Narsalar haqidagi ergash gapda none of dan keyin which; them uchun yangi gap kerak boʻlardi.
why.ru: После none of в придаточном о предметах — which; с them нужно было бы новое предложение.

why.ru: Remember + to + глагол — не забыть сделать то, что ещё нужно: remember to turn off.

why.ru: Try + -ing — попробовать другой способ, чтобы проверить, сработает ли он: try pushing.
